text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (The star... I had always longed for...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (The star... I had always chased after...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Watching continuously for about a year. Finally... finally, tomorrow...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, I can—run with you!
—The day of the Yayoi Sho, our first showdown with Admire Vega, has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Is the Class Rep here yet? Is she here yet?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I hope she does well.
She's always trying so hard, and she's taken such good care of us, too.

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Class Rep~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The cheers... I can hear them all the way over here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I want to win! More than ever before!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I understand how you feel, but...
Yeah, I understand how you feel, but...

text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road can only see what's right in front of her.
However, there is something she must not forget.

Yes, that this Yayoi Sho
is the trial race for the Satsuki Sho,
the first jewel of the Classic Triple Crown.

Throughout this year, Narita Top Road will likely
keep challenging Admire Vega.
Which is precisely why...

There is something more important than simply winning.
And that is—
choice_data_list: Let's figure out what makes our opponents so formidable and what their strengths are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Her intensity and unique flair...
Ayabe-san's...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I want you to go confirm it with all your might.
Yeah, I want you to go and see for yourself with everything you've got

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Understood! That's true,
I haven't actually run against
Ayabe-san in an official race yet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Learning her true strength is also an important objective! Thank you for the advice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ――Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let us have a fine race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with you.
And—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I want to be able to run like you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's... about to start.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...!

Neither Narita Top Road nor I know it yet.
The true core of the star known as Admire Vega.
I wanted to throw everything I'd built up against her, to somehow draw out her true strength and convictions.
